resale_co.name: Continuing Certificate of Inspection (CCI) for Sale, Transfer or Lease
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Hillsdale Fire Prevention Bureau / Code Enforcement Official (380 Hillsdale Avenue)
resale_co.lead_time: Must allow 10 business days for the inspection. CCI inspections are held Tuesday 4:00 to 6:00 pm.
requirements: Smoke alarms on each level and outside each separate sleeping area; 10-year sealed battery alarms (ANSI/UL 217), and AC-powered alarms from original construction may not be replaced with battery alarms

Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of the doorway or inside each separate sleeping area (battery, hard-wired or plug-in with battery back-up), unless the home has no fuel-burning device and no attached garage
Monitored or low-voltage fire alarm systems need an inspection or certification report from a NJ licensed electrician or alarm contractor showing the system works
Sump pumps must discharge directly to the exterior
Garage door openers plugged into a dedicated outlet (no adaptors or extension cords)
Front door dead bolt must be keyless (thumb-turn) on the inside
Dryer vents must vent directly to the exterior
Bedroom windows must operate and be the correct size for egress (especially attic and basement rooms)
House number visible from the street
No excessive debris or abandoned vehicles
Boiler, furnace and water heater flue connections secure at the chimney
Application asks whether there are open building permits
Portable fire extinguisher is no longer required (Fire Official memo of March 1, 2025)

fees.label: Continuing Certificate of Inspection (CCI) for sale, transfer or lease, inspection fee

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Borough's Application for Continuing Certificate of Inspection (CCI) for Sale, Transfer or Lease (linked from the Building, Construction & Zoning page) and pay by check made payable to the Borough of Hillsdale. Give the anticipated closing date and an inspection contact. Allow 10 business days. A missed appointment counts as the initial inspection and is a failure. Call 201-722-2612 to make an appointment.

resale_co.notes: Hillsdale runs one combined certificate, the Continuing Certificate of Inspection (CCI), which covers both the smoke/CO alarm check and a short list of code items (sump pump, dryer vent, dead bolt, egress, house number and so on). The application packet is a scanned PDF (no text layer), so the quotes from it were read from the page images and an automated text check will not find them. The packet has a Fire Official memo dated March 1, 2025, the CCI application, and a June 2021 homeowner checklist. The application cites Hillsdale Borough Ordinance 18-18, which was not found in the online code. The CCI is signed by the Code Enforcement Official. Hillsdale rental-only rules (lead-based paint inspections of rental dwellings, short-term rental limits in Chapter 234) are not resale requirements.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level and outside each separate sleeping area; 10-year sealed battery type (ANSI/UL 217); hardwired alarms may not be swapped for battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of the doorway or inside each sleeping area
Extra smoke and CO alarms if bedrooms are in separate areas of the home
Proof that any monitored or low-voltage fire alarm system works (report from a NJ licensed electrician or alarm contractor)
Portable fire extinguisher no longer required (per the Bureau's March 1, 2025 memo)

authorities.name: Hillsdale Fire Prevention Bureau (Hillsdale Fire Department), through the Continuing Certificate of Inspection
authorities.lead_time: Allow 10 business days; CCI inspections Tuesday 4:00 to 6:00 pm. Certificate valid 60 days.

authorities.how_to_apply: The smoke and CO alarm check is part of the CCI. Submit the CCI application to the Fire Prevention Bureau, 380 Hillsdale Ave., with a check to the Borough of Hillsdale.

fire_cert.notes: There is no separate smoke certificate fee; the $100.00 CCI fee covers the inspection, with $50.00 for a re-inspection. The Bureau's March 1, 2025 memo confirms the portable fire extinguisher is no longer required, matching P.L.2025, c.19.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: The CCI application asks whether there are open building permits; call the Building Department (201-722-2612) to check before the inspection.

other_items.label: Sump pump discharge
other_items.detail: Sump pumps must discharge directly to the exterior (CCI checklist item).
